title: Doko Porter Trail
tagline: Steady the load on the mountain trail, pace your breath, rest in time.
description: Carry a loaded doko up a hill trail in Nepal. One thumb leans the load and sets your pace; stone steps jolt it, bridges sway, the wind pushes. Rest at the right places and reach the village before dusk. Hints that teach, a Daily Trail and Watch and Learn.
howToPlay: Touch and hold to walk; lift your thumb to rest.
Drag sideways to lean and keep the load upright.
Drag up or down to hurry or slow your steps.
Slow down on steps, break your step on bridges.
Rest on a chautara to catch your breath.
